## 1. Professional Summary & Engineering Philosophy

Muhammad Sameer Ali is a frontend-focused full-stack developer with over 3 years of commercial software engineering experience building resilient, responsive web products with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, backed by Python and Node.js backend services.

At Deepixel, Sameer delivers core user-facing and workflow features for Invictus, an AI deal intelligence platform. His focus is translating complex product and AI requirements into usable, dependable interfaces with rock-solid engineering.

Key engineering tenets:
- **Product-Minded Engineering**: Clarify core business requirements before writing code. Align user friction points directly with architectural choices.
- **Resilient State Management**: Favor explicit state machines over ad-hoc boolean flags. Handle network disconnections, partial streaming, and concurrent updates gracefully.
- **Measurable Web Performance**: Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS < 0.1), utilize bundle splitting, pre-render static shells, and eliminate client rendering bottlenecks.
- **End-to-End Quality Validation**: Protect systems with multi-viewport automated testing (Playwright, Vitest), strict TypeScript compilation, and reproducible Docker configurations.

## 2. Commercial Experience

### Deepixel — Full-Stack Developer
- **Timeline**: April 2026 – Present
- **Location**: Remote / Hybrid
- **Product**: Invictus — Enterprise AI Deal Intelligence and Reporting Platform
- **Core Stack**: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Tiptap, Laravel, Server-Sent Events (SSE), Playwright, Docker
- **Key Contributions & Metrics**:
  1. **Streaming AI Report Workspace**:
     - Built an interactive AI report generation engine utilizing Server-Sent Events (SSE) to deliver real-time progress markers and intermediate generation steps.
     - Implemented user clarification prompts allowing operators to provide missing deal parameters mid-generation without dropping existing streaming state.
     - Architected automatic timeout recovery and partial draft persistence, ensuring users never lose report drafts during unexpected network disconnects.
  2. **Mobile Application Shell & PWA**:
     - Engineered a responsive mobile and tablet application shell with persistent bottom navigation tabs and touch gestures.
     - Configured Progressive Web App (PWA) manifest and service worker caching strategies, fixing standalone mode authentication loss.
     - Adapted high-density desktop data tables, multi-step deal creation wizards, and analytics charts for small viewports down to 320px.
  3. **Rich Document & Table Editing Engine**:
     - Stabilized Tiptap table extensions by resolving stale-state overwrites during concurrent edits and complex HTML exports.
     - Fixed nested-table parsing bugs and built custom controls for table row/column manipulation, cell merging, and formatting.
     - Implemented robust report review, validation, and PDF/DOCX export pipelines.
  4. **Display Scaling for High-DPI Windows Laptops**:
     - Diagnosed layout clipping and overlap issues affecting enterprise users with Windows 125% and 150% display scaling.
     - Developed dynamic CSS viewport calculations and a persistent user zoom toggle, allowing seamless readability on high-DPI laptop screens.
  5. **Automated Visual Testing & Quality Assurance**:
     - Authored comprehensive Playwright test suites executing automated screenshot regression tests across 21 distinct application views and four viewport tiers (mobile, tablet, laptop, desktop).
     - Wrote 17 report-flow utility unit and integration tests, ensuring zero regressions across sprint cycles.
     - Enforced strict TypeScript checks (`tsc --noEmit`) and clean production builds in continuous integration pipelines.
  6. **Local Development Orchestration**:
     - Created unified Docker Compose environments with health-check scripts, mitigating environment configuration drift across engineering teams.

## 3. Flagship Projects & System Architectures

### Project 1: WordWanderer — Gamified Language Learning Platform
- **URL**: https://msameerali.dev/projects/wordwanderer
- **Live Demo**: https://wordwanderer.vercel.app
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SameerAli126/WordWanderer
- **Stack**: Next.js 14, TypeScript, Zustand, MongoDB Atlas, Express.js, Tailwind CSS
- **System Architecture**:
  - Gamification Engine: Built XP progression loops, daily learning streaks, hearts/gems economy, and leaderboard ranking systems.
  - Spaced Repetition System (SRS): Developed an algorithmic review scheduler calculating memory decay curves based on user recall history.
  - Dynamic Question Runner: Interactive question interfaces supporting multiple modes: multiple choice, audio pronunciation matching, Hanzi character stroke recognition, and sentence reordering.
  - Offline-Ready Architecture: IndexedDB caching allowing users to complete lessons offline, synchronizing state with MongoDB upon reconnecting.

### Project 2: OptiTrade 3.0 — Stock Market & Portfolio Dashboard
- **URL**: https://msameerali.dev/projects/optitrade
- **Live Demo**: https://opti-trade-3-0.vercel.app/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SameerAli126/OptiTrade-3.0
- **Stack**: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, TanStack Query, JWT, Tailwind CSS
- **System Architecture**:
  - Real-Time Calculations: Engineered mathematical portfolio analytics calculating unrealized P&L, weighted average costs, and asset allocations with sub-15ms execution.
  - Market Data Feeds: Integrated external financial market APIs with aggressive query caching and deduplication via TanStack Query.
  - Secure Authentication: Stateless JWT authentication paired with refresh-token rotation in secure HTTP-only cookies.
  - Visual Data Exploration: Interactive candlestick and line charts rendering historical price movements across custom timeframes (1D, 1W, 1M, 1Y, ALL).

### Project 3: InvoiceGen Pro — AI-Assisted Invoicing Suite
- **URL**: https://msameerali.dev/projects/invoicegen-pro
- **Live Demo**: https://invoicegen-pro.netlify.app/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SameerAli126/invoicegen-pro
- **Stack**: Next.js 15, Gemini 2.0 Flash AI, MongoDB Atlas, Stripe, Tailwind CSS
- **System Architecture**:
  - Generative AI Drafting: Leveraged Google Gemini AI to transform unstructured user prompts and receipt images into structured, line-itemized invoice drafts.
  - End-to-End Billing: Integrated Stripe checkout sessions and webhooks for real-time payment confirmation and automatic status updates.
  - Document Export: High-fidelity client-side and server-side PDF generation producing clean, branded invoice printouts.
  - Client Management: Comprehensive customer ledger tracking outstanding balances, payment histories, and automated reminder schedules.

### Project 4: PhotoStream / SnapCloud — Cloud Media Platform
- **URL**: https://msameerali.dev/projects/photostream-snapcloud
- **Live Demo**: https://portfolio.tail81be07.ts.net
- **Repositories**:
  - PhotoStream: https://github.com/SameerAli126/PhotoStream
  - SnapCloud: https://github.com/SameerAli126/snapcloud
- **Stack**: React, TypeScript, Vite, FastAPI (Python), MongoDB Atlas, Cloudinary CDN
- **System Architecture**:
  - Dual Frontend Implementations: Developed two distinct client experiences (PhotoStream tailored for desktop photography portfolios; SnapCloud tailored for mobile social media interaction) consuming a unified backend.
  - Asynchronous Microservice: Built a high-concurrency FastAPI service handling chunked image uploads, metadata extraction (EXIF data), and tag-based search.
  - Media Delivery CDN: Integrated Cloudinary for on-the-fly image transformations, responsive WebP conversion, and low-latency edge delivery.
  - Access Control: Role-based access control (RBAC) governing public vs. private media collections.

### Project 5: SAMIO — Local-First Personal Finance & Operations Dashboard
- **URL**: https://msameerali.dev/projects/samio
- **Live Demo**: https://portfolio.tail81be07.ts.net:8443/login
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SameerAli126/SAMIO
- **Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL
- **System Architecture**:
  - Passwordless Authentication: Secure email One-Time Password (OTP) verification with cryptographically signed session tokens.
  - Relational Schema Integrity: Designed normalized PostgreSQL schemas with foreign keys and cascaded deletions modeling income streams, categorized expenses, and recurring subscriptions.
  - Data Export & Portability: Full JSON and CSV export capabilities ensuring user data ownership.
  - Responsive Dashboard Layouts: Distinct desktop grid views and collapsible mobile cards with optimized touch targets.

### Project 6: Peshawar Civic GIS Atlas — Civic Open Data & Geolocation Platform
- **URL**: https://msameerali.dev/projects/peshawar-civic-gis-atlas
- **Live Demo**: https://portfolio.tail81be07.ts.net:10000
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SameerAli126/PCA
- **Stack**: Laravel, PHP, Leaflet, MariaDB, Bootstrap / Custom CSS
- **System Architecture**:
  - Geospatial Exploration: Leaflet mapping engine displaying public facilities, infrastructure networks, and municipal administrative zones across Peshawar.
  - Dataset Validation Pipeline: Administrative ingestion tools parsing CSV/GeoJSON datasets, checking coordinates, verifying geometry bounds, and logging audit provenance.
  - Role-Based Publishing: Multi-tier authorization allowing public viewing, surveyor submissions, and administrative publication approval.
